Q1.cypher: MATCH (r:Drug)-[:TREATS]->(d:Disease {id:'D017'}) RETURN r.id AS a ORDER BY a
Q1.sparql:
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
SELECT ?a WHERE { ?r ex:treats ex:D017 . BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?r),'http://example.org/') AS ?a) } ORDER BY ?a

Q2.cypher: MATCH (r:Drug {id:'R020'})-[:TREATS]->(d:Disease)-[:ASSOC_GENE]->(g:Gene) RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS a ORDER BY a
Q2.sparql:
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?a WHERE { ex:R020 ex:treats ?d . ?d ex:assocGene ?g . BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?g),'http://example.org/') AS ?a) } ORDER BY ?a

Q3.cypher: MATCH (r:Drug)-[:TREATS]->(d:Disease) RETURN d.id AS a, count(r) AS n ORDER BY n DESC, a LIMIT 10
Q3.sparql:
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
SELECT ?a (COUNT(?r) AS ?n) WHERE { ?r ex:treats ?d . BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?d),'http://example.org/') AS ?a) } GROUP BY ?a ORDER BY DESC(?n) ?a LIMIT 10

Q4.cypher: MATCH (d:Disease {id:'D155'})-[:SUBCLASS_OF*1..30]->(x:Disease) RETURN DISTINCT x.id AS a ORDER BY a
Q4.sparql:
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?a WHERE { ex:D155 ex:subclassOf+ ?x . BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?x),'http://example.org/') AS ?a) } ORDER BY ?a

Q5.cypher: MATCH (d:Disease {id:'D076'})-[:ASSOC_GENE]->(g:Gene)<-[:ASSOC_GENE]-(o:Disease) WHERE o.id <> 'D076' WITH o, count(DISTINCT g) AS s WHERE s >= 2 RETURN o.id AS a, s ORDER BY s DESC, a
Q5.sparql:
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
SELECT ?a (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?s) WHERE { ex:D076 ex:assocGene ?g . ?o ex:assocGene ?g . FILTER(?o != ex:D076) BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?o),'http://example.org/') AS ?a) } GROUP BY ?a HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) >= 2) ORDER BY DESC(?s) ?a
